results.text: Discovery of KDX1381, a Bivalent CK2α Inhibitor for the Treatment of Solid Tumors as a Single Agent or in Combination. Casein kinase 2 (CK2) has emerged as a promising therapeutic target across a broad spectrum of malignancies, including pediatric and orphan cancers. The identification of a ligandable allosteric αD pocket on the CK2α subunit has enabled the development of bivalent inhibitors, which bind simultaneously to both the adenosine triphosphate (ATP) site and the allosteric pocket.
